en: Thank you for worrying about me. But I'm fine... I'm sure of it...
Yes, I'm fine... Whatever the enemy, I won't let my guard down.
No, it doesn't bother me... I've come this far... All I can do is fight with all my heart.
Yes... Thank you, Angel.
Angel, please don't worry so much. I'll be all right.
I'm sure you'll be all right, Cecia.
Thank you... Angel... I'll do my best.
Please don't worry like that. I'm sure it'll be all right, Angel.
It's all right, Angel. Please calm down.
No, this is because I wasn't strong enough. I'm sorry I couldn't be of use to you, Angel...
I'm sorry, Angel...{wait}{clear}But I feel so relieved that you came. Thank you.
Um... please don't worry about it so much. I wanted to be of use to you, and instead this happened...
No, it's not your fault, Angel. So please don't let it trouble you.{wait}{clear}Besides, if you were always there with me in every battle, I'd end up depending on you...
I'm sorry, I'm all right...{wait}{clear}But if you can, will you come again? Just having you here calms my heart...
No, that's not true. It isn't your fault, Angel.{wait}{clear}I did this myself, so you're not to blame. Please don't apologize.
It's all right, Angel. I was so happy that you relied on me...{wait}{clear}And yet I couldn't live up to it. I'm sorry.{wait}{clear}I... I will become stronger. I promise.
No, you're wrong. I simply wasn't strong enough.{wait}{clear}...I think it was a good lesson. Thank you... Angel...
No. I don't think I was careless.{wait}{clear}But... it's clear my strength fell short. I have to try harder...
Yes... Thank you, Angel...{wait}{clear}I want to get well and serve you again.
The Forest
This Reyforia Forest is truly beautiful.
Thank you, Angel!{wait}{clear}It makes me so happy to hear you say that about my beloved forest.
The forest is wonderful.
Yes, truly... People and animals both live on the forest's gifts...
To you, Cecia, this forest is...
A very precious place. And what I fear most is the order of this forest being destroyed...{wait}{clear}I want to keep protecting it, always.
The Legend
Could you tell me about the legend?

Yes...{wait}{clear}The legend is the story of Diana-sama, who long ago was guided by an angel and saved the world from crisis.{wait}{clear}They say Diana-sama's will has been handed down ever since, and that even now she protects this forest from a certain place.{wait}{clear}And with love, we call each Diana-sama in turn the Holy Mother.{wait}{clear}I think almost every girl in the forest looks up to Diana-sama.
The legend means...
What the legend means...? That... that's a story for another day...
Please keep passing it on...
Yes... I will... Angel.
No... sorry, but being thanked just makes me feel pathetic...
Yeah... What about you? Aren't you tired?
Strange thing to say... I'm not fighting just for your sake.
You always think that, and you come anyway.
What good is it if you can't stay calm?
It's not as if I did it for you...
...Even if you apologize to me...
Do I really look that unreliable? Well, I might get lost if I went into a forest or something...{wait}{clear}Then you can go find the way for me. You can fly with those wings, after all.
...Geez, what good is it if you can't stay calm? Making a face like that just makes me nervous, you know?
No, it's pointless to count on you for that... Don't worry about it too much.
You apologizing just puts me on the spot. Besides, this is because I wasn't strong enough, not because of you.
Don't say another word... I don't want to hear your excuses.
How rude! I may not look it, but my sense of direction is perfect.{wait}{clear}Besides, even if I get a little lost, Vesta will help me.
Yeah, I think they're working hard.{wait}{clear}At first I thought they'd be a nuisance. And they even gave Vesta a fright. We've had lots of fun times.

You still ask the strangest things.{wait}{clear}Well, I don't love it or hate it... I sometimes stay up reading grimoires, and Vesta is nocturnal, after all.{wait}{clear}But I do like napping somewhere nice and warm.
Nothing in particular... Oh, I do check that Vesta's come home before I go to bed.
Yes... I understand. Please don't worry, Angel.
Yeah... I know... It's just that even I can't give it my all when I'm worn out, so it's fine to rest a little, right?
Don't say that after we've come this far! ＄＄＄＄＄＄, don't make that face. Pull yourself together!
Are you the ones attacking the village?
Titan
Humans attacked us first!! With beasts we'd never seen, they...{wait}{clear}We're only paying them back... Anyone in our way gets crushed!!
I don't want to fight, but... here I come.
Is it over...?
Hmph! All talk!!
Soldier
Shut up and obey us! Resist and you die!
Wahaha! Resisting the Imperial Army is useless!
Why is the Empire doing this?!
Knight
None of your business. We'll spare no one who hinders our march!
Why come all the way out here?
You could never match the Imperial Army! Wahahahaha...!
What is that...?
Phantom
None of your business... We'll spare no one who defies us!
These Imperial moves... What is about to happen?
Getting in our way... You fool!
So you're the ones who did this...
Who are you? Defying us is out of the question!
Damn it... How long will this go on...?
Kaiser
You'd defy the Imperial Army? Interesting... Here I come!!
To die for my country as an Imperial knight is all I ask... But one last favor...
If you meet an Imperial knight named Leyla, tell her I wished to apologize for killing her men...
Hmph... Defying us... How foolish...
That man... had his soul stolen by a cursed sword...
This sword is pleased too...
The blood of an angel's hero is the finest, it says...
Hahaha! An angel's hero can't even soothe my sword!
Captain
Long live the Empire!!
Where's the one who dares defy us?!!
Ngh... Imperial troops... Are there still more?
You think you can beat us?!!
Hyaah! I'll be your opponent!!
T-too strong...
You were a worthy foe...
You can't possibly beat me! Wahahaha!
Bandit
I'm gonna take you down.
Here I come!
Hah! No way you can beat us!
Who are you?
We've been underestimated, it seems.
Zombie
Grrrr...
Rest quietly, and return to the earth...
Uurrgh...
Vampire
I have no time to talk with you. Here I come!
Mere humans can't hope to match us!
Oh, it ran away! Wahahaha...!
Medusa
Ohoho...
Losing to a demure lady like me... What a pathetic man...
Assassin
Huh? Who are you? Don't get in our way!
With people like that around, Legrance must have its share of trouble...
Serves you right.
Hah! It ran off!
Demons in the Imperial Army?
I have to stop the Empire...
Imperials
Hahahahaha!
I can't let you run wild any longer.
Don't get in our way!
Damn...
That'll teach you!
Titan
Wh-what do you want...{wait}{clear}Th-this is our land now. Get out!
I won't let you do as you please any longer.
D-don't ever come back!!
Savio
You're... the angel's hero Serenis spoke of...
I'll kill you.
You know Serenis?
The witch who gave me this armor...{wait}{clear}But I'll tell you no more... There's no point telling a dead man anything...
Gh, ghhh...
Gaaaah!!
Those in my way... die.
Raaah!
Damn... I wanted to see the world end with my own eyes...
You... hate this world that much...?
None of your business.{wait}{clear}I'll be waiting for you in hell...
So long, angel's hero.{wait}{clear}...Don't worry, I'll be along later too.
Hahaha! Serves you right!
Attacking even a little town like this?! The Empire!!
